item.title: One Injured in Route 901 Crash Involving Disabled Tractor Trailer in Butler Township
item.description: One person was injured Monday morning following an incident involving a disabled tractor trailer and a utility vehicle along Route 901 near Lavelle.According to Butler Township Police, the incident occurred around 11:45 a.m. on Route 901 on the hill north of Lavelle. item.title: PSP Seeking Owner of Firearm Found in Schuylkill County, Recovered After Vehicle Repossessed in Harrisburg
item.description: The Pennsylvania State Police are attempting to make contact with the owner of a firearm that was recovered in Schuylkill County. According to police, the firearm is a 9mm caliber SCCY CPX-2 handgun, serial number C002952, described as pink and black in color. State police say the firearm was found on September 23, 2025, inside a rental vehicle at Mike Watchers Used Cars, located at 637 Minersville–Lewellyn Highway in Branch Township, Schuylkill County. item.title: John Deatrich Announces Candidacy for 123rd District State House Seat
item.description: John Deatrich has announced his candidacy for Pennsylvania State Representative in the 123rd Legislative District. Deatrich, a lifelong resident of the district, confirmed his campaign on February 2, saying he plans to bring his experience in education, organized labor, and local government to Harrisburg.
